stem: What is ironic about the parents' belief that their son is honest?
instruction: Read the following line from Scene 3 of the play.

options.label: A
options.text: The boy realizes that the witness is unable to talk about the agreement.

options.label: B
options.text: The boy does not want to reveal to the banker where his parents are.

options.label: C
options.text: The boy explains that the banker said he would not collect the money owed.

options.label: D
options.text: The boy lies in court in order to get the banker to tell the truth.

visual_elements: NARRATOR: The boy's parents know that their son is honest, so they have gone to court to let a mandarin decide what to do.
